name: FlowingMenu-TS-TW
blurb: Full-height menu with continuous marquee text and image reveal on hover.
description: A GSAP-animated menu where each item is a full-height link with continuously scrolling marquee text and images. On hover, a marquee panel slides in from the nearest edge (top/bottom) with animated logo and images.
use_when: You want a sophisticated, image-heavy navigation menu that feels premium and modern.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces or accessibility-first designs — hover-based edge detection may not work well.
a11y: Links are semantic and have href. Marquee content is hidden with pointer-events-none. Edge detection based on mouse position only.
